rows.description: Monitor agent successfully ingests traces from 10+ completed workflows
All 5 built-in evaluators (Resource, Latency, Error, Decision, Compliance) execute without errors
Evaluation reports contain scores, findings, and recommendations in both Markdown and JSON format
Trace storage handles 100K+ events with query response time < 1s for single workflow JSONL file
Generated reports correctly identify known performance issues in test workflows
Evaluation results are deterministic and reproducible (rule-based evaluators; LLM evaluator within acceptable variance)
Configuration changes (thresholds, enabled evaluators) apply without code changes via monitoring-config.json
System overhead measured at < 3% of monitored workflow execution time
Retrospective analysis works on existing MEMORY/WORK/ session logs
Baselines established from first 50 monitored workflows
Self-monitoring audit log captures all monitor executions
Monitor agent receives trace events within 500ms of emission during live workflows
Live dashboard displays real-time metrics for 10+ concurrent agents
Anomaly detection triggers voice notification + JSONL alert within 2s of threshold breach
System handles 100 events/second without dropped traces
Historical and live data queryable through unified CLI interface
Monitor agent successfully pauses workflow when critical error detected
Intervention events logged with full audit trail (who, what, when, why)
False positive rate for interventions < 5%
Workflow resume after intervention completes successfully
Documentation includes: architecture diagram, configuration guide, evaluator API, example custom evaluator
Integration tests cover all evaluation scenarios with fixture traces
CLI provides programmatic access to evaluation results and metrics
System runs continuously for 7 days without manual intervention
